description: Record whether this lead agreed that the quality of their enquiry may be reported back to the advertising platform it came from. Nothing is ever reported without this. Three states: true (given), false (refused), null (never asked — behaves like refused when sending, but is a different fact). Always say where the consent came from (source), e.g. 'meta_lead_form' or 'web_form' — a consent without a provenance is worth nothing if it is ever disputed.

source.description: Where the consent was given, e.g. 'meta_lead_form'.

name: set_marketing_consent
